beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Judgment Engines examines the systems that decide whether other outputs are good enough.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those decisions can shape rewards, selection, and institutional actions without appearing in the final interface.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book argues that a reliable judge is an engineered procedure, not merely a model prompt.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects rubrics and evaluation methods with evidence, security, calibration, and accountable authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to distinguish a repeatable score from a judgment that measures the intended quality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The central requirement is that an automated evaluator must itself remain open to evaluation and challenge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A judgment may rank candidates, trigger revision, shape training, or permit a consequential action.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those uses turn evaluation into part of the system's behavior.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore separates what is assessed from the norms governing its assessment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also distinguishes the procedure from the authority attached to the result.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A score can be reproducible while expressing the wrong standard for its purpose.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This foundation explains why better prompting alone cannot settle the engineering problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different judgments require different forms, including comparison, critique, grading, or a veto.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An explicit rubric states the qualities the evaluator is supposed to recognize.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Without that definition, apparently precise scores can conceal an unstable meaning of quality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines how criteria become instructions, examples, and evidence requirements.
